description: Open perp positions of traders (the venue's own liquidity vaults are left out), ordered by size, PnL, leverage, recency or liquidation risk. Amounts in USD.

limit.description: How many positions to return (1-50, default 15).

symbol.description: Only this market, for example ADA-USD or ADA.
